claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Mofezolac is a COX-1-selective NSAID that does not induce apoptosis or reactive oxygen species in cultured cells and lacks antiproliferative cytotoxicity at 2.5 uM, so it is expected to be largely inactive in a 5-day pooled viability screen.
